messages:
Sam K: Hey everyone, Sam here— joining infra this week. I'm trying to attach our GCP project to the billing account so I can run some smoke tests, but gcloud is throwing permission errors. Also don't see the AWS dev account in the console. Who's best to ping for both sides? :wave:
Devon (infra): Welcome! For GCP you'll need billing permissions on the billing account and link rights on the project. Typical roles we grant for this flow: Billing Account User on the billing account and Project Billing Manager on the project. Which billing account ID are you trying to use?
Sam K: It's 0123-ABCD-4567. I attempted:
```
gcloud beta billing projects link --billing-account=0123-ABCD-4567 --project=redwood-dev-mltest
```
and got:
```
ERROR: (gcloud.beta.billing.projects.link) permission denied: billing.resourceAssociations.create
```
Alex - IT: For AWS: do you SSO via Okta? If so, you should see a list of accounts. If dev isn't there I can add you to the devs-sso group (gives Console role assume). We avoid broad IAM admin by default.
Sam K: I SSO, but only see prod-account and infra-ops. Can you add me to devs-sso?
Alex - IT: Filing the group add now, should be done ~30m. Also note region whitelist: us-central1 and europe-west1 are approved. If you need other regions for a short experiment say which ones.
Devon (infra): On our side I'll try to attach the billing account. Sometimes org policy blocks linking so I may need the project owner to approve. Quick checklist for you to verify:
- billing.googleapis.com API enabled on redwood-dev-mltest
- You're running gcloud as the same principal you used to sign the console (service accounts vs user creds can differ)
- Project has at least Project Editor/Owner to change billing settings
If you paste the project id I'll start the audit.
Sam K: project id is redwood-dev-mltest. I enabled the billing API earlier but maybe did it under a different account.
Maria L: Welcome Sam! Ping the onboarding doc: https://redwood/handbook/onboarding/cloud-access for the checklist. We usually ask folks to open a "Project Billing Link" ticket so infra can review and keep an audit trail.
cloud-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-0153  label: infra; assignee: Devon (infra)
Sam K: Thanks all. I'll wait for the SSO group add and the billing link update. Happy to run any commands if you need live debug.
Devon (infra): I'll post back once the link is complete or if we need a project owner to click confirm. If you need temporary access for debugging we can give you a scoped role for 24h. :thumbsup:
Sam K: Appreciate it 64f
